output.explanation: NIG-UK:1900045457 invoices NIG-SA GBP 8,400.00 for the D. Becker secondment (P-24088). NIG-SA:ICV-SA-019035 books GBP 7,980.00 against the same reference 9000010808 and is described as 'net of WHT 5%'. The 0.95 ratio matches the 5% Saudi WHT rate on services, so the GBP 420.00 gap (USD 539.85 at the invoice-date rate) is withholding tax, not an error.
output.recommended_action: NIG-UK should obtain the WHT certificate from NIG-SA and reclassify GBP 420 from the IC receivable to withholding tax expense or a recoverable tax asset, so both sides agree at GBP 7,980.
output.adjustment_description: In NIG-UK, debit withholding tax expense (or WHT recoverable) GBP 420 and credit the IC receivable from NIG-SA GBP 420 for the 5% Saudi WHT withheld on invoice 9000010808.
